originalTitle: What JEPQ Actually Paid the Last Time the Nasdaq Fell 10%: a Stress Test for Its 10% Yield
summary: JEPQ promises softer Nasdaq landings and a 10% yield, but the real question is whether those monthly checks and price cushions actually hold up when the index starts bleeding. The answer from two very different market storms might surprise income investors.
content:
The JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF ( NASDAQ:JEPQ ) exists to answer one question: can you own the Nasdaq without owning the full whiplash? JEPQ pairs a portfolio of large-cap Nasdaq names with a written-call overlay, converting a slice of upside into monthly cash.

JEPQ’s roughly 10.9% trailing distribution rate is what keeps income investors interested. The useful test is what actually happens to the price and the checks when the index rolls over, because both halves of the trade are supposed to activate at exactly that moment.

JEPQ holds a research-driven subset of Nasdaq-100 stocks and sells out-of-the-money index calls against them, mostly through equity-linked notes. Premiums collected on those calls, plus dividends from the underlying stocks, form the bulk of the monthly distribution.

When implied volatility rises, those call premiums fatten, which is why the payout is designed to breathe with market stress. The fund carries a 0.35% net expense ratio, cheap for an actively managed derivative-income product.

The 2026 Correction: A Real Cushion Showed Up

The Nasdaq-100 entered correction territory this spring. The VIX peaked at 31.05 on March 27, 2026, and stayed above 20 from late February through mid-April. That is exactly the environment the overlay is built for. Measured from the December 1, 2025 setup into the August 5 close, the Invesco QQQ Trust ( NASDAQ:QQQ ) returned 16% while JEPQ returned 10% over the same window. JEPQ dropped meaningfully less than the index into the March lows, then lagged the sharp rebound, which is textbook covered-call behavior.

As volatility spiked, so did the checks. Monthly distributions climbed from $0.46572 in February to $0.509 in March, $0.5586 in April, $0.59095 in May, and eventually to $0.70497 on the August 3 ex-date, the largest single payout in the fund’s history. Trailing twelve-month distributions now sit at $6.52319 per share against a $59 price. Higher volatility literally paid the holder.

The 2022 bear market is where the marketing gets thinner. From JEPQ’s May 4, 2022 inception through year-end, the fund fell 13%, only modestly better than a Nasdaq-100 that fell far more painfully over the calendar year.

Payouts ran from $0.33975 in July 2022 to $0.68125 in November 2022, with December adding another $0.57554. The checks kept arriving and briefly grew, but the price cushion in a true, grinding drawdown was smaller than the 10% yield headline implies. Owners of JEPQ still lost real capital in 2022; they just lost less than the pure index and got paid to sit through it.

JEPQ makes sense as a 5% to 10% income sleeve for a retiree or near-retiree who wants Nasdaq beta with softer drawdowns and a monthly check that grows when markets get scary.

It does not make sense as a core Nasdaq holding for anyone still compounding: a plain QQQ position kept more than five percentage points of return over the last twelve months and roughly six over the recent correction round-trip. The cushion and the checks are real, and so is the growth you hand over to earn them.

chineseTitle: 上次纳斯达克下跌 10% 时 JEPQ 实际支付了多少：对其 10% 收益率的压力测试
chineseSummary: JEPQ 承诺纳斯达克登陆温和，收益率为 10%，但真正的问题是，当指数开始下跌时，这些月度检查和价格缓冲是否真的有效。两次截然不同的市场风暴的答案可能会让收益投资者感到惊讶。
chineseContent:
摩根大通纳斯达克股票溢价收入 ETF（纳斯达克股票代码：JEPQ）的存在是为了回答一个问题：您可以在不拥有全部鞭打的情况下拥有纳斯达克股票吗？ JEPQ 将纳斯达克大盘股的投资组合与书面看涨期权覆盖相结合，将一部分上涨空间转化为每月现金。

JEPQ 大约 10.9% 的追踪分配率让收益投资者保持了兴趣。有用的测试是当指数展期时价格和检查实际发生的情况，因为交易的两半都应该在那个时刻激活。

JEPQ 持有纳斯达克 100 股票的研究驱动子集，并主要通过与股票挂钩的票据出售针对这些股票的价外指数看涨期权。这些看涨期权收取的权利金，加上基础股票的股息，构成了每月分配的大部分。

当隐含波动率上升时，看涨期权溢价就会增加，这就是为什么派息旨在随着市场压力而呼吸。该基金的净费用比率为 0.35%，对于主动管理的衍生收益产品来说相对便宜。

2026 年修正：真正的缓冲出现

纳斯达克 100 指数今年春天进入调整区域。 VIX指数于2026年3月27日达到31.05的峰值，并从2月下旬到4月中旬一直保持在20以上。这正是覆盖层所针对的环境。从 2025 年 12 月 1 日成立到 8 月 5 日收盘，Invesco QQQ Trust（纳斯达克股票代码：QQQ）的回报率为 16%，而 JEPQ 在同一窗口内的回报率为 10%。 JEPQ 跌幅显着小于该指数进入 3 月份低点，然后滞后于大幅反弹，这是教科书上的备兑看涨期权行为。

随着波动性的飙升，支票也随之增加。每月派息从2月份的0.46572美元攀升至3月份的0.509美元，4月份的0.5586美元，5月份的0.59095美元，最终在8月3日除息日升至0.70497美元，这是该基金历史上最大的单笔派息。过去 12 个月的股息目前为每股 6.52319 美元，而每股价格为 59 美元。更高的波动性确实为持有人带来了回报。

2022年的熊市是营销力度减弱的时候。从 JEPQ 于 2022 年 5 月 4 日成立到年底，该基金下跌了 13%，仅略好于纳斯达克 100 指数，而纳斯达克 100 指数在历年的跌幅要大得多。

支出从 2022 年 7 月的 0.33975 美元增至 2022 年 11 月的 0.68125 美元，12 月又增加了 0.57554 美元。支票不断到达并短暂增长，但真正的、痛苦的回撤中的价格缓冲小于 10% 的收益率标题所暗示的。 JEPQ的所有者在2022年仍然损失了实际资本；他们只是损失少于纯指数，并获得报酬来忍受它。

对于退休人员或接近退休人员来说，JEPQ 是一个 5% 到 10% 的收入保障，他们希望纳斯达克测试版的提款更温和，并且每月支票会在市场变得可怕时增加。

对于仍在复利的人来说，作为纳斯达克的核心持股是没有意义的：简单的 QQQ 头寸在过去 12 个月中保持了超过 5 个百分点的回报，在最近的回调中保持了大约 6 个百分点的回报。缓冲和支票是真实的，你为赚取它们而付出的增长也是真实的。
